Ensemble strategy to combine all expert outputs for comprehensive system design.

routing.reasoning: Leave management system is a classic approval workflow with medium complexity (6 sequential steps, branching for approve/reject decisions). ApprovalWorkflowExpert specialized for multi-step approval processes with notifications. SQL for relational data (employees, leave requests, balances, approval history). AdvancedFormExpert for complex validation (date ranges, leave balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert for employee mobile access. PageExpert for dashboard and calendar views. Ensemble strategy to combine all expert outputs for comprehensive system design.

routing.reasoning: Leave management system is a classic approval workflow with medium complexity (6 sequential steps, branching for approve/reject decisions). ApprovalWorkflowExpert specialized for multi-step approval processes with notifications. SQL for relational data (employees, leave requests, balances, approval history). AdvancedFormExpert for complex validation (date ranges, leave balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert for employee mobile access. PageExpert for dashboard and calendar views. Ensemble strategy to combine all expert outputs for comprehensive system design.

Ensemble strategy to combine all expert outputs for comprehensive system design.

Ensemble strategy to combine all expert outputs for comprehensive system design.

name: Submit Leave Request

data.description: Employee initiates leave request submission

data.description: Check if request meets all policy requirements

data.description: Create leave request record with status 'Pending' and assign to manager for approval

data.label: Notify Employee & Manager

data.description: Inform employee that leave balance is insufficient for the requested dates

data.label: Notify Policy Violation
data.description: Inform employee about policy violations and required corrections

data.label: Request Submitted
data.description: Leave request successfully submitted and pending approval

data.label: Request Rejected
data.description: Leave request rejected due to insufficient balance or policy violation

routing.reasoning: Leave management system is a classic approval workflow with medium complexity (6 sequential steps, branching for approve/reject decisions). ApprovalWorkflowExpert specialized for multi-step approval processes with notifications. SQL for relational data (employees, leave requests, balances, approval history). AdvancedFormExpert for complex validation (date ranges, leave balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert for employee mobile access. PageExpert for dashboard and calendar views. Ensemble strategy to combine all expert outputs for comprehensive system design.

ApprovalWorkflowExpert specialized for multi-step approval processes with notifications. SQL for relational data (employees, leave requests, balances, approval history). AdvancedFormExpert for complex validation (date ranges, leave balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert for employee mobile access. PageExpert for dashboard and calendar views. Ensemble strategy to combine all expert outputs for comprehensive system design.

data.description: Update LeaveBalance record with new balance after deduction

data.label: Create Balance History
data.description: Log balance change in BalanceHistory for audit trail

data.label: Log Rejection
data.description: Record rejection in ApprovalHistory without balance update

data.label: Notify Employee
data.description: Send notification to employee about balance update or rejection

data.label: End
data.description: Balance update process complete

name: Manual Balance Adjustment
description: Workflow for HR users to manually adjust employee leave balances with validation, approval tracking, and notifications

data.label: Start Balance Adjustment
data.description: HR initiates manual leave balance adjustment process

data.label: Enter Adjustment Details

data.description: Validate employee exists, leave type is valid, and adjustment amount is within allowed limits

data.description: Check if all validation rules passed

data.label: Notify Validation Error
data.description: Send error notification to HR user with validation failure details

data.label: Update Leave Balance

data.label: Log Audit Trail
data.description: Create audit log entry with HR user, timestamp, old balance, new balance, and reason

data.label: Notify Employee & Manager
data.description: Send notification to employee and their manager about balance adjustment

data.label: Adjustment Complete
data.description: Manual balance adjustment process completed successfully

data.label: Adjustment Failed
data.description: Manual balance adjustment process terminated due to validation failure

routing.reasoning: Leave management system is a classic approval workflow with medium complexity (6 sequential steps, branching for approve/reject decisions). ApprovalWorkflowExpert specialized for multi-step approval processes with notifications. SQL for relational data (employees, leave requests, balances, approval history). AdvancedFormExpert for complex validation (date ranges, leave balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert for employee mobile access. PageExpert for dashboard and calendar views. Ensemble strategy to combine all expert outputs for comprehensive system design.

Ensemble strategy to combine all expert outputs for comprehensive system design.

name: Send Approval Notification
description: Sends notification to employee when manager approves their leave request, updates approval history, and logs the notification

data.label: Start
data.description: Triggered when manager approves leave request

data.label: Validate Approval Data
data.description: Verify approval record exists and contains required data (LeaveRequest, Manager, Approval status)

data.label: Update Approval History
data.description: Create ApprovalHistory record with approval details and timestamp

data.label: Prepare Notification Content
data.description: Fetch EmailTemplate and populate with employee name, leave dates, manager name, and approval details

data.label: Send Email Notification
data.description: Send approval notification email to employee using prepared content

data.label: Log Notification
data.description: Create NotificationLog entry for audit trail and tracking

data.label: Send Push Notification?
data.description: Check if employee has push notifications enabled in preferences

data.label: Send Push Notification
data.description: Send push notification to employee's mobile device

data.label: End
data.description: Approval notification process complete
